About Us

Since1996

Good food and real hospitality bring people together. That idea has guided Pizza Villa & Pasta House in Bridgenorth since the day we opened.

Today we are a local favourite for families, friends and food lovers. Dine in, take out, or get delivery. You are always welcome.

Our History

  1. 1996: One oven, one big idea

    A local family opened Pizza Villa & Pasta House with a few menu items and a lot of heart. Generous portions, quality ingredients and friendly service quickly built our name.

  2. Growing with the community

    As Bridgenorth grew, so did we. We added to the menu, refined our recipes and updated the space, while keeping the traditions that made us special.

  3. Today: a multi-generational favourite

    Regulars keep coming back, kids grow up with their favourite slice, and new faces are greeted like old friends.
